gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-vi: Authoritative and synthwave-bright, Outrun Future spaces its letters wide with one constant-width outline. Noto Sans Vithkuqi is the quieter partner, its open throats and tiny cap-to-lowercase step keeping every line smooth.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-wa: Outrun Future draws every line like rod stock, horizontals and verticals identical in thickness. And Noto Sans Wancho, with its hulking chalk-pressed lowercase, would make a long paragraph feel dense, sturdy and unhurried.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-onest: Outrun Future keeps its letters wide apart and traces each outline at a constant width. Onest then settles into the paragraph, short ascenders above big bowls and a gentle monotone line, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-open-sans: Wide and synthwave-sharp: Outrun Future spaces its letters out and holds every stroke to a constant width. Open Sans then carries extended text smoothly, with no clogged curves and sturdy, bulky lowercase.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-orienta: Counters that breathe and capitals barely taller than the lowercase make the text slip past quickly. Orienta lets Outrun Future's wide-set, swell-free outline do all the shouting, and that restraint is the best thing about them.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-parkinsans: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide, each outline a constant-width line. Parkinsans holds one stroke thickness everywhere, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk, which is its real strength.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-prompt: Outrun Future goes wide and authoritative, every outline a stencil-cut channel. Prompt takes over below with oversized-looking small letters and open apertures that keep a full paragraph readable from start to finish.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-pt-sans-capt: Wide-set and unapologetically synthwave: Outrun Future traces each letter in a ruler-straight, constant-width line. And PT Sans Caption, with its big-bodied lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls, gives that line something friendly to land on.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-radio-canada: Outrun Future is built to announce, with wide letter spacing and a constant-width outline you could trace. Radio Canada is built to be read, its tall, full lowercase and open curve endings carrying the words quietly.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-ruda: Outrun Future draws a constant-width outline with wide gaps between its letters, made to announce. But Ruda, with its wire-like monoline skeleton and sizable x-height, is the one built for screen reading.
